extensionDescription.message: Move the current Chrome tab to any available monitor in one click. Give your screens custom names and skip dragging windows.

actionTitle.message: Tab to Screen — move your tab to another monitor

intro.message: Choose a monitor for your current tab.

editorHint.message: Numbers match the map. Leave a name blank to use the name reported by Chrome.

singleMonitor.message: Chrome can see only one screen in this session. Check the monitors in your remote session, then refresh.

namesIntro.message: A familiar name for every screen.

nameInputTitle.message: Name for screen $1; reported by Chrome: $2

saveNamesError.message: Could not save the names. Please try again.

moveUnconfirmed.message: Chrome did not confirm the move.

finishEditing.message: The layout may have changed. Save or cancel the names to refresh the list.

noActiveTab.message: Open the extension in the window containing the tab you want to move.

noDisplays.message: No monitors are available in this session. Check your screens and refresh.

displayReadError.message: Could not retrieve the monitors. Please try again.

moveInProgress.message: Wait for the current move to finish.

moveError.message: Could not move the tab. Check that the tab and monitor are still available, then try again.

invalidWorkArea.message: The monitor does not have a valid available area.

invalidSelection.message: Select a valid tab and monitor.

displayGone.message: This monitor is no longer available. Refresh the list and choose another screen.

windowUnconfirmed.message: Chrome did not confirm the destination window. Check where your tab is before trying again.

pinWarning.message: The tab was moved, but could not stay pinned.

maximizeWarning.message: The tab was moved, but the window could not be maximized.

destinationWarning.message: Your system did not keep the window on the selected monitor. Check the screens available in your session.

verificationWarning.message: The tab was moved, but the destination monitor could not be confirmed.
